decisionModel.title: Decision model
decisionModel.connectionJevHelp: Jev chooses among your enabled models.
decisionModel.connectionOpenRouterHelp: Jev, through OpenRouter, chooses among your enabled models; the chosen model then answers through its own provider. Only enabled models ever answer.
decisionModel.disclosure: Off by default. Enable a decision model for supported decisions in this workspace. When off, Kasal uses its existing approach. Unavailable or uncertain decision model answers also fall back to that approach. Relevant prompts and candidate content are sent to the decision model provider when enabled.
decisionModel.keyMissing: Add {{key}} in Configuration → API Keys, then reopen this panel.
decisionModel.loadError: Could not load decision model settings. Reopen Configuration to retry.
decisionModel.saveError: Could not save decision model settings. A workspace admin and an API key are required to enable the decision model.
decisionModel.recommend: Ask the decision model for a recommendation
decisionModel.systemCaption: Applies to every workspace. Each workspace admin still turns the decision model on for their workspace in its Models settings, with the workspace's own {{key}}.
decisionModel.urlHelp: Where the {{name}} decisions API lives. Empty keeps the decision model off for every workspace.
decisionModel.urlScheme: Must start with http:// or https://
decisionModel.urlUnencrypted: Plain http is not encrypted: prompts and candidate content travel in clear text. Use it only on a private network.
decisionModel.urlHelpOpenRouter: OpenRouter's API. Empty uses its public API.
decisionModel.systemSaveError: Could not save the decision model connection.
